method: Each definition in s31-mutation-defs.json applied alone by exact text replacement, its whole test file run with the vitest JSON reporter, every touched file restored and compared by SHA-256, then the whole file rerun. A proof needs the named row to fail on an AssertionError, a byte-identical restore and an all-passing rerun; other failing rows are recorded. The integration files run the real paypal/start and paypal/complete route handlers on a local PostgreSQL database built from the migrations, with the three Neon URLs removed; PayPal is a fake labeled FIXTURE, so no order exists. The unit file reads the buttons source, drives the loader with a fake document and the handlers with a fake fetch; the window, focus and the switch to the redirect link are browser evidence in 00-status.md, not a test here.
